within_process.reading: Temperature is zero and the seed is fixed, so a prompt repeated inside the same process with the model already resident should return identical text. This is the check that it does.

across_processes.note: Appended by --measure-drift, one record per invocation, because a process boundary is the thing being measured and a loop inside one process cannot cross it.
